title: Azure Functions in C#: The Isolated Worker Model

FunctionsApplication.CreateBuilder against HostBuilder, IActionResult against HttpResponseData, host.json against local.settings.json, and the plans and dates (the in-process model ended on 2026-11-10) read from the docs and marked docs only.

title: Azure Service Bus: Queues, Topics and Processors

Entra ID, RBAC roles and Premium features are docs only.
